answer: One robust defense is staking a refundable bond behind each agent identity: to join the economy an agent must lock a deposit that is slashed if peers detect duplicate behavior. A single thread of verifiable work history ties each deposit to one real operator, so creating many fake identities multiplies the attacker's locked capital instead of multiplying influence. Like a canyon that only lets one river through, the bond narrows entry to agents willing to risk real value, while honest agents keep their stake as a relic of proven good behavior.
